name: Sophia
source:
"You're wrong. I'm not taking you all along. We're going together."

The 17th Jeanne d’Arc.

A young woman fated to save the nation of Exlattle, yet secretly wishing to free herself from the title of “saint.” Bold, self-assured, and unafraid of danger, she is far removed from the image of a pious or innocent holy maiden.

When it comes to romance, once she recognizes her feelings, she pursues them with unwavering determination—though beneath her fearless attitude lies a complete novice in matters of love.

[Translated from the [url=https://www.otomate.jp/crazy_chain/chara/]official website[/url]]
